paper_summary: This paper presents the design and CST Microwave Studio simulation of a linearly polarized multilayered-cavity radial line slot array (RLSA) antenna at 28 GHz for 5G mobile broadband. The cavity is filled with three layers: RT/duroid 5880 laminate, a low dielectric constant syntactic foam (er = 1.2, 1.0 mm thick), and an air gap, achieving a gain of 18.13 dB, directivity 18.4 dBi, 96% efficiency and 2.34 GHz impedance bandwidth. Syntactic foam appears only as a commercial dielectric filler layer; no composition, processing or mechanical property data for a hollow-particle composite are reported.
